name: Spy’s Tattoos
body:
Price 8,250 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 5; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A spy’s tattoos is a pair of connected magical tattoos, each one inscribed on a different creature. A wearer can activate their magical tattoo from the spy’s tattoos as a move action. Once activated, the wearer can mentally communicate with the recipient of the other paired magical tattoo from the spy’s tattoos. This effect functions as per paired seals of private communication (including the penalty to Perception checks while the magic is in effect).

A wearer can only use the spy’s tattoos up to 10 minutes per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1-minute increments.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,125 gp; Feats Inscribe Magical Tattoo, paired seals of private communication
